parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` (line 35) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` (line 45) — reside in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and both carry `is_test: true`.
